Permission.value: Photo taken in 1916 by an unknown photographer in Zurich, Switzerland for a publicity postcard to promote the 1916 programme of the Cabaret Voltaire in Zurich. The Kunsthaus Zurich holds a large reproduction of this photo (Dada-Sammlung, inventory # VI:5) and also doesn't know the photographer. See also Hess, Birgit: »Sphäre des Wilden ... Sphäre des Spiels« Masken und Puppen im Dada Zürich: ›Agenten‹ der Alterität und Performanz, PhD dissertation, 2003/2006, University of Trier, Germany, pp. 190ff and p. 420. As an anonymous work published 1916 in Switzerland, the Swiss copyright on this photo would have expired on January 1, 1947, and in the EU the photo would have gone out of copyright on January 1, 1987.

Rathaus - Spiegelgasse

Cabaret Voltaire was the name of an artistic nightclub in Zürich. It was founded in 1916 by Hugo Ball, with his companion Emmy Hennings, in the back room of Holländische Meierei as a cabaret for artistic and political purposes. Events at the cabaret proved pivotal in the founding of the anarchic art movement known as Dada.
